newsitem.title: UK: Britain not yet ready to take Zaire troop decision.
newsitem.headline: Britain not yet ready to take Zaire troop decision.

text.p: Britain will take a preliminary decision in the next "couple of days" on whether to contribute personnel to a proposed international humanitarian force in eastern Zaire, officials said on Tuesday.

"I expect that over the next couple of days, ministers will take preliminary judgements," one official said. "It looks likely that there will be an international force and there will be interest here in contributing to it if we can, (and) if there is a workable military plan."
The officials said Britain's decision would greatly depend on what the United States decided to do.

The United Nations may give a green light to the deployment of a multi-national force in Zaire within 48 hours, Spain said earlier. Canada has offered to lead the force but the United States and Britain have yet to make up their minds on joining.
"It is far from clear that there is a straightforward military and civilian situation into which a force could be inserted," the official said.
"We are potential contributors but we have not made up our minds."
